title: Vampire Wars
justification: Checked by title. The film is TMDB movie 142356 (Vampire Wars (1990)). TheTVDB lists this 50-minute 1990 OVA, ヴァンパイヤー戦争, only as movie 107096 Vampire Wars (1990-11-30, 50 minutes), whose IMDb id tt1176472 is Vampire Wars (Video 1990). Its TMDB link points at another film, so the TMDB id is the matching TMDB page, movie 142356 Vampire Wars (1990-11-30). The OVA marker stays.
